VISION:
Our Core Value
Global Culture Finance Leader, EverTreasure
MISSION: EverTreasure is a fintech company building the financial infrastructure for art and culture. Using STO (Security Token Offering) technology, we let anyone own a fractional share of art and creative assets — and we use AI to uncover value in culture that’s always been real, but never before measurable. That’s the foundation for a truly global creative economy.
CORE_TECH_EVERSEAL_TITLE: EverSeal — Trust, Recorded on the Blockchain
CORE_TECH_EVERSEAL_DESC: Description: Just like the NFC chip in this keyring, EverSeal pairs NFC technology with blockchain to permanently and securely record an artwork’s details and ownership history.
CORE_TECH_EVERSEAL_TAMPERPROOF: Tamper-Proof: Once locked, ownership and history cannot be forged.
CORE_TECH_EVERSEAL_TRACKING: Global Tracking: Verifiable status anywhere in the world.
CORE_TECH_VALQ_DESC: Description: We move beyond intuition. VALQ analyzes market data to predict the future value and revenue of films, art, and musicals.
CORE_TECH_VALQ_DATA: Data-Driven: Analyzes trends, transaction history, and artist growth.
CORE_TECH_VALQ_INVESTMENT_STANDARD: Investment Standard: Provides objective indicators for rational investment decisions.
PLATFORM_YEATU_TITLE: YEATU - Creative Investment Platform (STO-based Alternative Investment)
PLATFORM_YEATU_DESC: YEATU is a platform where fans become investors. We issue Security Tokens (STO) that share the future profits of Art Content. Supported by a secure financial structure with BNK Kyongnam Bank and global securities firms.
PLATFORM_EVERLYNQ_TITLE: EverlynQ - Global IP Matching Platform (Connection Hub)
PLATFORM_EVERLYNQ_DESC: EverlynQ is a platform for creators to build their careers and connects creators with global enterprises. We facilitate real commercial projects, enabling IP matching, contracting, and global collaboration.
PLATFORM_OWNIT_TITLE: OWNIT — Art Commerce Platform (Discover Your Taste. Own the Value.)
PLATFORM_OWNIT_DESC: OWNIT is an art commerce platform that brings art into everyday life. From original works by verified artists to curated creative goods, we present and sell art in a way that’s easy to understand and easy to choose. We turn artistic value into something you can actually own.
VALUE_HUNTERS_TAGLINE: Those Who Discover What Others Miss
VALUE_HUNTERS_DESC: The world is full of hidden gems—unknown artists and overlooked masterpieces. Equipped with AI and blockchain, LUMI and her companions are elite value hunters who identify potential others fail to see. What they discover is secured in YEATU, a vault where value is preserved and shared through fractional ownership.
VALUE_HUNTERS_LUMI_DESC: LUMI uses AI-driven insight to spot future stars early, turning overlooked potential into undeniable value.
VALUE_HUNTERS_TENZO_DESC: TENZO preserves every origin, transaction, and trace of history, ensuring nothing valuable is ever lost.
VALUE_HUNTERS_BELLA_DESC: BELLA creates viral momentum that transforms quiet works into global conversations.
VALUE_HUNTERS_NUA_DESC: NUA stabilizes the ecosystem by absorbing volatility and maintaining balance between creators and investors.
VALUE_HUNTERS_SHIRO_DESC: SHIRO blocks forgery and manipulation, protecting authenticity with uncompromising precision.
